Adaptable Elemental.name: Adaptable Elemental
Adaptable Elemental.description: Str +1, Dex +4, Con +3, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +0; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Anchored Incorporeality.name: Anchored Incorporeality
Anchored Incorporeality.description:
While most ghosts are bound to the site where they died or were buried, some instead find themselves bound to specific items, such as a particular piece of jewelry, article of clothing, pet's collar, or a stone from a building in which it dwelled. Estos items, known as anchors, were important to the ghost in life, or critical to the events of their death and haunting.

A criatura with anchored incorporeality has the incorporeal rasgo, meaning it can move through physical criaturas and such criaturas can move through it. It can't attempt Strength‑based checks (such as @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Grapple]{Grapple}) against corporeal criaturas and corporeal criaturas can't attempt such checks against it. Though incorporeal, a criatura with anchored incorporeality can travel no more than 60 pies from its anchor and must maintain line of effect to the anchor. Este typically prevents it from moving through walls. Unlike many other incorporeal criaturas, a criatura with anchored incorporeality doesn't have resistance to all daño or immunity to daño de precisión.

A character with an animal companion or familiar that has anchored incorporeality can transfer the anchor to a new item with a special ritual. Este requires spending 1 week in concert with the companion to create a new anchor. A character who knows this technique might be able to adapt it to transfer a ghost's Site Bound ability (or similar restriction) to tie it to an anchor instead of a place.

Angelic Avenger.name: Angelic Avenger
Angelic Avenger.description: Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Angelic Emissary.name: Angelic Emissary
Angelic Emissary.description: Str 12, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 14; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Angelic Mercy.name: Angelic Mercy
Angelic Mercy.description: Tu eidolon's angelic power allows them to assuage a variety of ailments, just like most other powerful angels. Tu eidolon can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} two times per day, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind} una vez al día, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BCuHKrDeJ4eq53M6]{Sure Footing} una vez al día each as 9th-rank divine innate conjuros.

Anger Aura.name: Anger Aura
Anger Aura.description: Tu eidolon exudes wrath in an aura around it, rousing the ire of nearby criaturas and causing their defenses to crack as they seethe with rage. Tu eidolon gains a 20-pies anger aura, which has the aura, emotion, enchantment, mental, and occult rasgos. The resistances of any criatura in the aura, including tú, tu allies, tu enemies, and tu eidolon, are reduced by an amount equal to 3 + tu eidolon's Constitution modifier. Tu eidolon can hold in its rage by spending a single action, which has the concentrate rasgo. Este reduces the aura's effect to affect only tu eidolon. It can take this action again to reinstate the full effect of its aura. Las criaturas in a barbarian Rage, Seething Frenzy, or similar ability that allows them to channel their anger aren't affected by the anger aura.

Animal Companion.name: Compañero animal
Animal Companion.description:
The following are the base statistics for a young animal companion, the first animal companion most characters get. Tú adjust these statistics depending on the type of animal tú elige. Animal companions calculate their modifiers and DCs just as tú do with one difference: the only item bonuses they can benefit from are to Velocidad and AC (their maximum bonificador por objeto to AC is +3). As obtienes levels, tú might be able to make tu companion stronger by advancing it.

An animal companion's starting statistics are as follows.

  • Level: Tu animal companion's level is equal to yours.
  • Proficiencies: Tu animal companion is entrenado in its ataques sin armas, unarmored defense, barding (a type of armor for animals), all tiradas de salvación, Perception, Acrobatics, and Athletics. Animal companions can't use abilities that require greater Intelligence, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} or Decipher Writing, even if entrenado in the appropriate skill, unless they have a specialization that allows it.
  • Attribute Modifiers: An animal companion begins with base attribute modifiers listed in its stat block.
  • Puntos de Golpe: Tu animal companion has ancestry Puntos de Golpe from its type, plus a number of Puntos de Golpe equal to 6 plus its Constitution modifier for each level tienes.

Beast's Charge.name: Carga de la bestia
Beast's Charge.description: Tu eidolon can make a ferocious charge or pounce on foes, allowing it to quickly engage. It gains the @Compendium[pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.ITQghUQFhbYpD2QM]{Beast's Charge} activity.

Blasphemous Decree.name: Blasphemous Decree
Blasphemous Decree.description: Tu demon utters indescribable words writhing with its associated sin. It can cast an evil @Compendium[pf2e.conjuros-srd.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C]{Divine Decree} una vez al día as a 9th-level conjuro. Estás unaffected by this decree, even if tú aren't evil. At 19th level, this becomes a 10th-level divine decree instead.

Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
Breath Weapon.description:
Tu eidolon exhales a blast of destructive energy. Tu eidolon deals 1d6 daño to all criaturas in the area, with a basic Reflex save against tu conjuro DC. The area and tipo de daño of the Breath Weapon are chosen when the eidolon gains this ability. Tu eidolon then can't use their Breath Weapon again for the next [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the daño increases by 1d6.

Brutal Beast.name: Brutal Beast
Brutal Beast.description: Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Construct Heart.name: Construct Heart
Construct Heart.description: Tu construct eidolon has a link directly to tu life force, which renders it a living criatura and therefore susceptible to many ailments that bother only the living, though it does possess some resistances to these effects. It doesn't have a construct's normal immunities, but does gain a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to tiradas de salvación against death effects, disease, necromancy, and poison effects, as well as effects causing the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Fatigued]{Fatigued} or sickened conditions. Additionally, its astral essence bleeds off slowly, and it only needs to succeed at a Flat Check to remove daño persistente de sangrado (or a Flat Check after receiving particularly effective aid).

Creeping Plant.name: Creeping Plant
Creeping Plant.description: Str 12, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 14, Cha 10; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Cunning Dragon.name: Cunning Dragon
Cunning Dragon.description: Str 12, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 12; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Demonic Strikes.name: Demonic Golpes
Demonic Strikes.description: Tu eidolon's attacks are corrupted by the Abyss and imbued with pure evil and shifting chaos. Tu eidolon's unarmed Golpes gain the unholy rasgo and deal 1 daño adicional de espíritu to holy criaturas and criaturas with weakness to unholy. Additionally, elige one of tu eidolon's ataques sin armas that deals daño físico; it gains the versatile rasgo for a different type of daño físico tú elige.

Devotion Aura.name: Devotion Aura
Devotion Aura.description: After fighting at tu side for so long, tu eidolon has become as devoted to protecting tú and tu allies as it is to its original cause. It gains a 20-pies devotion aura, which has the abjuration, aura, and occult rasgos. Siempre que one of tu eidolon's allies within the aura takes daño, puedes reduce the daño by tu eidolon's Constitution modifier. Tú lose a number of Puntos de Golpe equal to half the amount by which the eidolon reduced the daño, rounded down. If the daño was lower than the Constitution modifier, base the daño sufres on the actual amount of daño prevented.

Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
Draconic Frenzy.description: Tu eidolon can make a furious assault, potentially recovering the use of their Breath Weapon. They gain the @Compendium[pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.HiVt4B5bE2hi0FWc]{Draconic Frenzy} activity.

Drain Life.name: Drenar La Vida
Drain Life.description: Tu eidolon's link with tú sustains it, but it still craves the life essence of the living, whether through blood or pure essence. It gains the @Compendium[pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.3Ns5BmFpAcoGQIY5]{Drain Life} activity.

Dutiful Retaliation.name: Represalias obedientes
Dutiful Retaliation.description: Tu eidolon deeply respects tu assistance, and it extends its loyalty to tú, attacking those who dare harm tú. It gains the @Compendium[pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.4NuAF8jxWDWzia9Z]{Dutiful Retaliation} reaction.

Efecto: Seething Frenzy.name: Efecto: Seething Frenzy
Efecto: Seething Frenzy.description: The criatura takes a -2 penalización to AC.

0.prompt: Select the Details of the Primary Golpe. Estos can be edited on the inventory tab later.

Eidolon Ability.name: Eidolon Ability
Eidolon Ability.description: The eidolon starts with an initial ability determined by the eidolon type.

Eidolon Defensive Expertise.name: Experiencia defensiva de Eidolon
Eidolon Defensive Expertise.description: Tu eidolon increases its ability to avoid attacks. Its proficiency rank for unarmored defense increases to experto.

Eidolon Defensive Mastery.name: Maestría defensiva de Eidolon
Eidolon Defensive Mastery.description: Tu eidolon's form becomes particularly difficult to assail. Its proficiency rank for unarmored defense increases to maestro.

Eidolon Symbiosis.name: Simbiosis de eidolones
Eidolon Symbiosis.description: Tu connection with tu eidolon strengthens, granting tu eidolon access to a new ability depending on its type, as described in Eidolon Abilities in each eidolon's entry.

Eidolon Transcendence.name: Trascendencia Eidolon
Eidolon Transcendence.description: Tu connection with tu eidolon approaches its peak, granting tu eidolon access to a powerful new ability depending on its type, as described in Eidolon Abilities in each eidolon's entry. Este ability also increases one of the eidolon's ability scores by 2.

0.prompt: Elige an Ability Score to Increase

Eidolon Unarmed Expertise.name: Experiencia desarmada de Eidolon
Eidolon Unarmed Expertise.description: Tu eidolon becomes more capable of using its ataques sin armas. Its proficiency rank for ataques sin armas increases to experto.

Eidolon Unarmed Mastery.name: Maestría desarmada de Eidolon
Eidolon Unarmed Mastery.description: Tu eidolon truly masters its ataques sin armas, reaching greater heights. Its proficiency rank for ataques sin armas increases to maestro.

Eidolon Weapon Specialization.name: Especialización en armas Eidolon
Eidolon Weapon Specialization.description: Tu eidolon has learned how to inflict greater injuries with its ataques sin armas. It deals 2 additional Damage with ataques sin armas in which it's an experto. Este daño increases to 3 if it's a maestro, and 4 if it's legendario.

Elemental Burst.name: Explosion elemental
Elemental Burst.description:
Frecuencia once per 10 minutes

Tu eidolon rips off a chunk of elemental matter from their own form and hurls it into a group of foes. Tu eidolon loses a number of Puntos de Golpe equal to tu level. All criaturas in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] within 60 pies take @Damage[(@actor.level - 1)d6] daño with a basic Reflex save against tu conjuro DC. The daño increases by 1d6 for each level tienes beyond 7th. The daño's type is either daño de fuego if tu eidolon is a fire elemental, or the same physical tipo de daño as tu eidolon's primary ataque sin armas if tu eidolon isn't a fire elemental. Elemental Burst gains any rasgos that tu eidolon's ataques sin armas gain from elemental core.

Elemental Core.name: Elemental Core
Elemental Core.description:
Tu elemental eidolon is an amalgam of elemental matter and mortal life force, which helps protect them from certain effects that are more harmful to mortals than elementals. They gain a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to tiradas de salvación against poison and sleep effects, as well as effects causing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} condition. Additionally, their elemental essence bleeds less easily than flesh, so the DC of any prueba plana they make to remove daño persistente de sangrado is 10 (or 5 after receiving particularly effective aid). Elige for tu eidolon to be an air, earth, fire, metal, wood, or water elemental. Tu eidolon and all their ataques sin armas gain the rasgo of the chosen element, and the eidolon gains additional effects based on tu choice.

Air: Tu eidolon is formed from elemental air and is light as a breeze. Tu eidolon can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} twice as far, and doesn't take falling daño.

Earth: Tu eidolon is formed from elemental earth, and is incredibly hard to move by force. Tu eidolon gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to their Fortitude or Reflex DCs against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} them. Este bonus also applies to tiradas de salvación against conjuros or effects that attempt to knock them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. In addition, if any effect would force them to move 10 pies or more, they're moved only half the distance.

Fire: Tu eidolon is formed from elemental fire and burns with embers of flame. Tu eidolon gains resistance equal to half tu level (minimum 1) to fire and an equal amount of weakness to cold and water. Their ataques sin armas deal 1 daño adicional de fuego.

Metal: Tu eidolon is formed from elemental metal and can adapt their metallic form to battle. One of tu eidolon's starting melee ataques sin armas gains the versatile bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing rasgo, as tu eidolon learns how to shift the metal into various weaponlike forms.

Water: Tu eidolon is formed from elemental water and swims with ease. Tu eidolon gains the amphibious rasgo, allowing them to breathe in water and air and to avoid the normal –2 penalización for making bludgeoning and slashing unarmed Golpes underwater. Tu eidolon's land Velocidad is reduced to 15 pies, and they gain a swim Velocidad of 25 pies. Puedes take the Amphibious Form feat to increase their land Velocidad back up to 25 pies, as described in the feat.

Wood: Tu eidolon is formed from elemental wood, and its living wooden form twists and regrows as tú focus tu elemental energies. Puedes elige to have tu eidolon gain the plant rasgo. Siempre que tú Refocus, tu eidolon regains a number of Puntos de Golpe equal to double tu level.

Elemental Maelstrom.name: Torbellino elemental
Elemental Maelstrom.description: Tu eidolon temporarily shifts its form into a swirling vortex of elemental matter and rampages through their foes. Tu eidolon Strides. During their movement, they can attempt a Golpe against each enemigo that is within their reach. If an enemigo comes within tu eidolon's reach more than once, tu eidolon makes only a single Golpe against a given enemigo. Estos attacks all count towards tu eidolon's multiple attack penalización, but the penalización doesn't increase until after all the attacks. If tu eidolon has the appropriate Velocidad, they can Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Zancada.

Enraged Assassin.name: Enraged Assassin
Enraged Assassin.description: Str 14, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 8, Cha 12; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Exploit Injury.name: Exploit Injury
Exploit Injury.description:
Requisitos The scout's last action was a successful melee Golpe against an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} target

Efecto El objetivo of the Golpe is desprevenido until the end of tu next turn.

Fey Chicanery.name: Fey Chicanery
Fey Chicanery.description: Ever full of tricks, tu fey eidolon twists magical protections into tu shared life force, granting it a contingency in its back pocket for desperate situations. During tu daily preparations, tu eidolon can cast a @Compendium[pf2e.conjuros-srd.WG91Z5TiR6oO5FOw]{Contingency} conjuro. The 4th-level conjuro it chooses must come from the primal or fey gift list, and must either be common or be another conjuro tienes access to.

Fey Gift Spells.name: Fey Gift Spells
Fey Gift Spells.description:
Tu eidolon expands tu primal magic with enchantment and illusion magic, allowing both of tú to wield the power of fey charm and glamour. When tú add conjuros to tu repertoire, puedes elige from the primal list as well as conjuros that have the illusion or mental rasgos that appear on the arcane conjuro list. As usual for when tú add conjuros of a different tradition to tu conjuro list, estás still a primal spellcaster, so all of tu conjuros are primal conjuros.

Tu eidolon gains the @Compendium[pf2e.feats-srd.WfbmFsRxbVyzMmCz]{Magical Understudy} summoner feat, despite not meeting the prerequisite level, and it can elige fey gift cantrips in addition to primal cantrips. As usual for a feat estás granted by name, puedes't retrain Magical Understudy into another feat.

Fey Mischief.name: Fey Mischief
Fey Mischief.description: Tu eidolon's fey magic becomes more powerful and mischievous. Tu eidolon gains the @Compendium[pf2e.feats-srd.b1eGMNjBY3iqIt2S]{Magical Adept} feat, despite not meeting the prerequisite level, and can elige from fey gift conjuros in addition to primal conjuros.

Field of Roots.name: Campo de raíces
Field of Roots.description: Tu eidolon learns how to send its roots underground to hinder foes. It gains the @Compendium[pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.4ZCaD8Y817JjbrX2]{Field of Roots} activity.

Fleet Beast.name: Fleet Beast
Fleet Beast.description: Str 14, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Follower.name: Follower
Follower.description:
A follower is an NPC who accompanies and assists tú for an extended period of time, perhaps even an entire campaign. Puedes gain a follower by taking the captain archetype. Followers are companions who rely upon tú for direction in combat; they have the minion rasgo. Puedes have a follower and a familiar or pet, but puedes't have a follower if tú already have an animal companion or another companion that prevents tú from having an animal companion.

Ancestry: Most followers are human, and so have the human and humanoid rasgos. They are size Medium, have a 25-pies Velocidad, and speak Common plus a number of additional languages equal to 1 + their Intelligence modifier. While followers have a heritage that is part of their personal story and background, followers don't gain mechanical benefits from their heritage. For information on followers of other ancestries, see the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.mW9uqRmI0Wi2qYSm]{Leader of All} feat.

Follower Type: Followers can come from all walks of life and have a wide variety of experiences and abilities. For ease of play, followers are grouped into broad categories called follower types, such as berserker or medic.

Kits: Each follower has a personal set of gear called a kit, which automatically improves as the PCs level up and has a level equal to the PCs' level. The kit includes the follower's armas, armor, and other items that they require to perform the actions listed in their statistics. Followers can't wear or use items other than those in their kit, nor can they share equipment with the PCs. A follower's daño with melee and ranged Golpes depends upon their follower type. Each follower type has a default arma listed; if tú would like tu follower to use a different arma that deals the same or lower daño from the same category (for example, simple melee arma or martial ranged arma) that requires the same number of hands to wield, talk to tu GM. Followers are assumed to maintain their kit. Este includes procuring adequate ammunition for ranged armas, as well as repairing damaged gear. A follower can spend 10 minutes to repair all their broken and damaged equipment, and they can replace destroyed equipment during daily preparations.

Payment: The follower mechanics abstract away the compensation that followers receive for their work, so as not to impact the expected party wealth. Followers are assumed to earn enough income to provide for their own food, clothing, and shelter, to maintain and upgrade their kits (see above), and to have a comfortable standard of living. The source of this income is up to the GM and player to decide based on the follower's circumstances; perhaps they have been hired by the PCs' patron or an outside organization to work with the PCs, or perhaps the PCs earn additional wealth in their adventures that is earmarked for the follower.

Replacing a Follower: Followers might part ways with the PCs for a variety of reasons, whether it be the follower's death or other events during the campaign. If a PC loses a follower, they can spend a week of downtime to replace them. Replacing a follower generally requires the PC to be in a settlement or other location where recruits are available, but the GM can also introduce followers organically during the adventure.

Following Shot.name: Following Shot
Following Shot.description:
Frecuencia once per turn

Desencadenante The sharpshooter critically hits with a ranged Golpe

Requisitos The sharpshooter is wielding a arma with reload 0

Efecto Bolstered by their success, the sharpshooter quickly takes another shot. They make another ranged Golpe with the same arma at the same multiple attack penalización. Este attack still counts toward the sharpshooter's multiple attack penalización.

Furious Strike.name: Furious Golpe
Furious Strike.description:
Tu eidolon channels its anger into a furious attack. It makes a melee Golpe. Este counts as two attacks when calculating tu multiple attack penalización. If this Golpe hits, tu eidolon deals an extra die of daño del arma and gains a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to the tirada de daño.

If estás at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice with a +2 bonificador de circunstancia, and if estás at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice with a +3 bonificador de circunstancia.

Greater Eidolon Specialization.name: Mayor especialización en Eidolon
Greater Eidolon Specialization.description: Tu eidolon's daño from arma specialization increases to 4 with ataques sin armas in which it's an experto, 6 if it's a maestro, and 8 if it's legendario.

Growing Vines.name: Growing Vines
Growing Vines.description: Tu eidolon's vines and branches lengthen even more. All tu eidolon's melee ataques sin armas gain the reach rasgo.

Guardian Plant.name: Guardian Plant
Guardian Plant.description: Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Hallowed Strikes.name: Hallowed Golpes
Hallowed Strikes.description: Tu eidolon's attacks are hallowed by the celestial realms. Tu eidolon's unarmed Golpes gain the holy rasgo and deal 1 daño adicional de espíritu to unholy criaturas and criaturas with weakness to holy. Additionally, tu eidolon can make nonlethal attacks with its ataques sin armas without taking the usual -2 penalización de circunstancia.

Haunting Visage.name: Semblante inquietante
Haunting Visage.description:
Requisitos Tu eidolon is condensed.

Tu eidolon suddenly shifts itself into a terrifying shape of its choosing, rather than a simple mound, by closely controlling the positioning of its component bodies. The eidolon attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a criatura within 15 pies; this Demoralize attempt loses the auditory rasgo, gains the visual rasgo, and the eidolon doesn't take a –4 penalización de circunstancia to the check if they don't share a language with their target. On a success or critical success, el objetivo is additionally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} for 1 round.

Hidden Watcher.name: Escondido Watcher
Hidden Watcher.description: Tu eidolon can render both of tú unseen. Una vez por hora, it can cast @Compendium[pf2e.conjuros-srd.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} targeting tú, them, or both of tú at once. If the conjuro targeted both of tú, the conjuro ends for both of tú if either of tú uses a hostile action.

Kit Armor.name: Kit Armor
Kit Armor.description: Tu follower is entrenado in this armor.

Marauding Dragon.name: Marauding Dragon
Marauding Dragon.description: Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 10; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Medic's Treatment.name: Medic's Treatment
Medic's Treatment.description:
Requisitos The medic is wearing or holding a healer's toolkit

Efecto The medic treats an adjacent criatura in an attempt to reduce the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition. If a criatura has multiple conditions from this list, the medic chooses one to treat. The medic attempts a counteract check against the condition, using their @Check[medicine] modifier as their counteract modifier and half their level as the counteract rank. The condition's source determines the DC.

The medic can't treat a condition that came from an artifact or an effect above 20th level. Using Medic's Treatment on a condition that is continually applied (for instance, the debilitado condition a holy criatura gains from carrying an unholy arma) has no effect as long as the circumstances continue.

Éxito crítico Reduce the chosen condition's value by 2.

Éxito Reduce the chosen condition's value by 1.

Fallo crítico Increase the chosen condition's value by 1.

Mindless Companion.name: Mindless Companion
Mindless Companion.description: Some undead companions are mindless. The mindless rasgo makes them immune to all mental effects, as normal. The only skills in which a mindless companion is entrenado are Acrobatics and Athletics, and it can't become entrenado in other skills. Even if a mindless companion gains a limited ability to act in combat without being commanded, such as from the Mature Animal Companion feat, it can repeat only the last command; it can't take a new action on its own. A mindless companion can't take specializations that would raise its Intelligence or grant it benefits to skills other than Acrobatics or Athletics, and it can't use or benefit from feats or other options for animal companions that normally require a criatura to have a mind, think, or make a decision. When in doubt, the GM determines what abilities a mindless companion can use.

Negative Essence.name: Negative Essence
Negative Essence.description: Tu undead eidolon has a link directly to tu life force, which grants it a twilight state between living and undead. Este renders it a living criatura and therefore susceptible to many ailments that bother only the living, though it does possess some resistances to these effects. The eidolon has negative healing, meaning it heals from negative energy effects that heal undead and is damaged by positive energy effects that daño undead. It doesn't have an undead's normal immunities, but it does gain a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to tiradas de salvación against death effects, disease, and poison effects, and non-damaging effects that target only undead. Additionally, its necrotic essence stanches its wounds easily. The prueba plana to remove daño persistente de sangrado from the eidolon is DC 10 (or DC 5 after receiving particularly effective aid).

Primal Roar.name: Rugido primigenio
Primal Roar.description: Tu eidolon unleashes a primal roar or other such terrifying noise that fits tu eidolon's form. Tu eidolon attempts Intimidation checks to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Demoralize]{Demoralize} each enemigo that can hear the roar; these Demoralize attempts don't take any penalización for not sharing a language.

Primordial Elemental.name: Primordial Elemental
Primordial Elemental.description: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int –1, Wis +1, Cha +0; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Quick Treatment.name: Quick Treatment
Quick Treatment.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The medic Strides and then uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.ma45EqTK72KQLca3]{Medic's Treatment}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]{Treat Poison}.

Reckless Attack.name: Reckless Attack
Reckless Attack.description:
Frecuencia once per turn

Desencadenante Tú Direct the berserker

Efecto The berserker gains a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to their next tirada de ataque on this turn. They are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the beginning of tu next turn.

Reconfigured Evolution.name: Reconfigured Evolution
Reconfigured Evolution.description: Tu construct eidolon is particularly easy to reconfigure, gaining an additional evolution that suits both of tu whims. Elige one additional evolution feat of 6th level or lower. Tu eidolon gains that feat. Puedes Retrain this feat for any other evolution feat of 6th level or lower with only a single day of downtime if tú succeed at a Crafting check, with a standard DC of tu eidolon's level. If tú fail, puedes try again on a later day. Many summoners elige Eidolon's Wrath for this ability.

Redistribute.name: Redistribuir
Redistribute.description:
Desencadenante Un enemigo's Golpe against tu eidolon is a critical hit.

Tu eidolon rearranges its component bodies in response to a powerful blow, mitigating the worst of the daño they would have taken. The triggering critical hit becomes a hit. Tu eidolon immediately switches forms, from condensed to dispersed or from dispersed to condensed.

Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
Rejuvenation.description: Tu eidolon's unusual connection with tú allows tú both to rejuvenate when defeated. The first time each day tu turn begins while estás dying, tú instantly regain a number of Puntos de Golpe equal to three times tu level and wake up. (Increase tu wounded condition as normal.) Puedes immediately Manifest Tu Eidolon as a free action. Puedes then take tu turn as normal.

Scout Construct.name: Scout Construct
Scout Construct.description: Str 14, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 12, Wis 10, Cha 8; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Scribe of the Dead.name: Scribe of the Dead
Scribe of the Dead.description: Str 12, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 14, Wis 12, Cha 10; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Seething Frenzy.name: Frenesí hirviente
Seething Frenzy.description: Tu eidolon can stoke itself into a frenzy. It gains the @Compendium[pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.7K6UJ3D3owmOQS03]{Seething Frenzy} action.

Share the Pain.name: Share the Pain
Share the Pain.description:
Desencadenante The berserker is critically hit by a criatura that is within their reach

Efecto The berserker makes a melee Golpe against that criatura.

Sickening Assault.name: Asalto nauseabundo
Sickening Assault.description:
Requisitos Tu eidolon is dispersed.

Tu eidolon focuses on inflicting the most daño possible on its foes. If tu eidolon's next action is to use Swarming Assault, the number of dados de daño of the Swarming Assault are doubled. Additionally, criaturas that fail their Reflex save against that Swarming Assault are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 4} on a critical failure).

Sickening Swarm.name: Sickening Swarm
Sickening Swarm.description: Tu eidolon is particularly good at distracting and hindering its foes while dispersed. While dispersed, spaces tu eidolon occupies are difficult terrain for other criaturas. In addition, tu eidolon gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.gGVaSvIhobXXsqTZ]{Sickening Assault} action.

Skirmisher Fey.name: Skirmisher Fey
Skirmisher Fey.description: Str 14, Dex 18, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 12; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Soul Guardian.name: Soul Guardian
Soul Guardian.description: Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 8; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Spirit Taker.name: Spirit Taker
Spirit Taker.description:
Tu eidolon is particularly capable when it comes to handling bodiless spirits and putting undead to their final rest. Tu eidolon can see incorporeal criaturas inside of solid objects and can attack them with Golpes without penalización; an incorporeal criatura in a solid object that takes daño from tu eidolon's Golpe is expelled from the object to the nearest available space, moving closer to tu eidolon if possible.

Additionally, tu eidolon can target or affect a criatura projecting its consciousness (such as via project image) or possessing another criatura, even if its body is elsewhere, though tu eidolon must know about the possession or projection and elige to do so.

Finally, the spirit of an undead destroyed by tu eidolon's Golpes is sent directly to the Boneyard for judgment; an undead with an ability to avoid such a fate automatically, such as a ghost's rejuvenation, can attempt a counteract check against tu conjuro DC to return via that ability as normal. In that case, it uses its Will save modifier as its counteract modifier.

Spirit Touch.name: Toque espiritual
Spirit Touch.description: Tu eidolon's attacks possess a psychopomp's ability to harm the living and the dead. Tu eidolon's unarmed Golpes affect incorporeal criaturas as though etched with a ghost touch property rune and deal an extra 1 void Damage to living criaturas and an extra 1 vitality Damage to undead.

Stalwart Guardian.name: Stalwart Guardian
Stalwart Guardian.description: Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 10; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Steadfast Devotion.name: Steadfast Devotion
Steadfast Devotion.description: Tu eidolon's dedication makes it extremely challenging for tu foes to bend its mind. Tu eidolon gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to tiradas de salvación against mental effects, and if they roll a success against such an effect, they get a critical success instead. If tienes the shared resolve class feature and tu eidolon rolls a critical failure against a mental effect, they get a failure instead.

Sudden Shift.name: Cambio repentino
Sudden Shift.description: Una vez por asalto, tu eidolon can switch forms between condensed and dispersed as a free action, rather than a single action. In addition, tu eidolon gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.8NK5Z7vLxkTB6pIV]{Redistribute} reaction.

Swarm Form.name: Forma de enjambre
Swarm Form.description:
Tu eidolon is an intelligent swarm composed of hundreds of Tiny criaturas, and it's immune to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} conditions. It can fit through tight spaces as though it were a Tiny criatura. It has weakness to area daño equal to its level. Tu eidolon has two forms: condensed and dispersed. When tú Manifest Eidolon, it manifests condensed. It can switch between these two forms as a single action that has the concentrate rasgo.

Condensed Form: When condensed, tu eidolon draws all its component bodies into a single, condensed mound that functions as a Medium criatura. It has a reach of 5 pies, can make Golpes, and can't occupy the same space as other criaturas. While condensed, it can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.roBX7VxpVKkRpClJ]{Haunting Visage} action.

Dispersed Form: When dispersed, tu eidolon scatters its component bodies across a wider area, increasing its size by one category (to Large for most swarm eidolons). It has a reach of 0 pies, can't make Golpes, and can occupy the same space as other criaturas. While dispersed, it can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.fUTBJxjPmiP4KVVI]{Swarming Assault} activity.

Swarming Assault.name: Asalto de enjambre
Swarming Assault.description:
Requisitos Tu eidolon is dispersed.

Tu eidolon swarms over each criatura occupying its space, biting, pecking, clawing, or making similar attacks with its component bodies. It deals @Damage[(1 + floor((@actor.level - 1)/2))d6[untyped]] daño to each criatura in the area, with a basic Reflex save against tu conjuro DC. Tú elige each time tu eidolon uses Swarming Assault whether it deals piercing or daño cortante. Tu eidolon then can't use Swarming Assault again for the next [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the daño increases by 1d6.

Swift Protector.name: Swift Protector
Swift Protector.description: Str 14, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 10; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Take Aim.name: Take Aim
Take Aim.description: The sharpshooter takes aim at their foe and makes a ranged Golpe, gaining a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to the tirada de ataque.

Tempter Demon.name: Tempter Demon
Tempter Demon.description: Str 12, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 16; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Tendril Strike.name: Tendril Golpe
Tendril Strike.description: Tu eidolon can stretch out vines and roots, attacking foes outside its reach. It gains the @Compendium[pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.fNTyFkFxNCi5O5SE]{Tendril Golpe} action.

Traveler's Aura.name: Traveler's Aura
Traveler's Aura.description:
Tu eidolon emanates a powerful aura-resembling that of an astral deva-that protects criaturas as they travel. The aura has the abjuration, aura, and divine rasgos. Tu eidolon and its allies within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] are protected from severe heat and cold, and tu eidolon is never @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Desprevenido]{Desprevenido} to criaturas inside the aura that are of a lower level than the eidolon.

When obtienes the transcendence class feature, this evolves to the full benefits of an astral deva; tu eidolon and allies in the aura are protected from environmental daño from any plane, including severe and extreme heat and cold as well as more unusual dangers.

Trickster Fey.name: Trickster Fey
Trickster Fey.description: Str 12, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 12, Wis 8, Cha 16; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Ultimate Reconfiguration.name: Ultimate Reconfiguration
Ultimate Reconfiguration.description: Tu construct eidolon becomes even more customizable. Elige an evolution feat of 16th level or lower. Tu eidolon gains that feat. Puedes spend downtime to adjust it using Crafting, just like the feat from reconfigured evolution. Many summoners select Ever-Vigilant Senses for this ability.

Visions of Sin.name: Visiones del pecado
Visions of Sin.description:
Frecuencia once per 10 minutes

Tu eidolon summons images of its sin into the mind of a target criatura within 30 pies, tormenting and confusing el objetivo. El objetivo must attempt a Will save against tu conjuro DC with the following effects. The effects last until the end of tu next turn, but tu eidolon can use a single action, which has the concentrate rasgo, to extend the effects until the end of tu next turn (like Sustaining a Spell), to a maximum duration of 1 minute. If el objetivo is evil, it takes a -2 penalización de circunstancia to its save. Regardless of whether it succeeds, el objetivo queda temporarily immune for 1 day.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo can't use reactions.

Fallo El objetivo is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Slowed]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Fallo crítico As failure, and el objetivo is also @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Confused]{Confused} for 1 round. The confusion can't be extended, but the other effects can.

Warrior Construct.name: Warrior Construct
Warrior Construct.description: Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 12, Wis 10, Cha 8; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Whirlwind Maul.name: Zarpazo de torbellino
Whirlwind Maul.description: Tu eidolon thrashes violently, damaging many foes in its reach. It gains the @Compendium[pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.W4VCL85CO77MYkQH]{Whirlwind Maul} activity.

Wrathful Berserker.name: Wrathful Berserker
Wrathful Berserker.description: Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 10, Cha 12; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Wrecker Demon.name: Wrecker Demon
Wrecker Demon.description: Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 8, Cha 12; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Wyrm's Breath.name: Aliento del Wyrm
Wyrm's Breath.description:
Frecuencia una vez por minuto

Tu eidolon gathers the power of the mightiest wyrms to make its magical breath even more spectacular. If tu eidolon's next action is to use Breath Weapon, both the number of dados de daño and area of the Breath Weapon are doubled.
